verdict.rationale: Deepgram's docs give a per-model language statement: the flux-general-multi model covers 10 languages with in-conversation switching. A first-party 'models-languages-overview' docs page also exists, which points to published model and language documentation. The pack never shows an actual concrete list of languages or a breakdown by feature. Missing for 10: an enumerated list of supported languages, per-model language matrices across models such as nova-3, per-feature language differences (e.g. diarization, smart formatting, audio intelligence), and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, the supported languages are published as a concrete list, with any per-model or per-feature differences stated

citations.quote: Multilingual (flux-general-multi, 10 languages with in-conversation language switching)
